title: Converting Distance in Kilometers to Miles

blocks.content: Converting Distance in Kilometers to Miles
To convert a distance in kilometers to miles, we need to multiply the distance in kilometers by the value 0.621. This is because:

Enter distance in km: 33
Distance in miles: 20.493000

items: scanf("%lf", &km); - takes distance input in kilometers from the user and stores it in the km variable
miles = km * conversionRatio; - computes the distance in miles by multiplying the distance in km by 0.621.

blocks.content: Notice how we used the double data type to represent the distance. Distances are generally floating-point numbers, such as 3.5 kilometers.
Next, you'll use a similar concept to convert temperature in Celsius to Fahrenheit.
